title: Kilishi
description: Kilishi is a Niger classic prepared with beef sirloin, ginger root, garlic, peanut. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. Fully cooked kilishi-inspired spiced beef, not traditional dried kilishi: authentic air-drying needs validated preservation methods.

steps.instruction: Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 90 minutes.
Lay spice-coated thin beef strips on a rack and roast until completely cooked and browned; this is not shelf-stable dried meat. Refrigerate leftovers promptly.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
